findings.evidence: The validation packet instructs facilitators to copy and populate tracked Markdown and JSON templates that contain free-text fields, while the branch ignore rules do not reserve a local-only session-results path.
findings.proposedCorrection: Store completed raw session forms in an ignored local-only directory and require an anonymization/consistency validator before producing bounded aggregate artifacts.

inputBlockers.evidence: No completed anonymized session form or populated aggregate session record was present.

methodologyRisks: The validation packet is on separate commit 1f84cc044e0aac1147a841568b40a5241c5659bc, not the evaluated PR head.
The current packet has no executable session validator or aggregate calculator.
Raw completed session storage is not isolated from tracked files, creating a privacy/confidentiality risk before R1-R5 collection.
Session records do not retain the observed exact head plus per-scenario dossier, timeline, and view-model hashes required by this pilot.
The 10-task 25-40 minute review guide and the 6-task 15-minute sprint gate use different timing protocols.
All three scored sprint scenarios have an OPEN specification window, so window-state comprehension is not directly tested.
Fit agreement after viewing system results is outcome concordance, not blind expert accuracy.
Five reviewers are sufficient only for a bounded pilot gate and not a population reliability claim.
nextActionOwnerOnly: Do not run facilitator sessions. A separate explicitly scoped change must first add an ignored local-only raw-session directory and a bounded anonymization/consistency validator.
decisionReason: Fewer than five valid sessions exist; no human metric can be computed without fabrication.
nonClaims: Synthetic regression success is not human technical-sales validation.
